# Two splits: one on an asset, liability or equity account, the other on an
# expense account. Here `Assets:Due From Director USD` −100.00 against
# `Expenses:Supplies:USD` +100.00.
#
# A director paid the supplier before the bill was posted.
#
# What this fixture produces: a USD transaction, neither split in a lot.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Supplies:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Due From Director USD
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-10 * "Director paid the supplier"
	guid: "aa11bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Expenses:Supplies:USD 100.00 USD
		guid: "bb22cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900aa11"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Due From Director USD -100.00 USD
		guid: "cc33dd44ee55ff6677889900aa11bb22"
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
